pages.text: Everything in Overgeared is forged with a $(item)smithing hammer$(). The first one is knapped from stone: right-click stone with $(item)flint$() to chip off $(item)rock$(), hold rock in both hands and knap a stone hammer head, then put it on a stick.

Better hammers come from the anvil: a $(item)copper$() head, and the $(item)steel smithing hammer$() from two heated steel ingots. A hammer only works on anvils and recipes its tier allows: "Incorrect hammer tier" means you need a better one.
